description: Unleash your adventure with the Totem Volcano Electric Mountain Bike, designed for power, endurance, and ultimate control. Featuring a 500W motor and a 48V 11.6Ah battery, this rugged e-bike delivers up to 50 miles of range, perfect for conquering challenging trails or long off-road rides. Its lightweight aluminum frame, 21-speed Shimano gearing, and advanced suspension fork ensure smooth handling and comfort across rough terrain. Whether you're exploring mountain paths or tackling steep climbs, the Volcano is built to elevate your ride.

components.description: The dual disc brakes ensure safe and reliable stopping power in any conditions, providing improved riding safety and maneuverability on bumpy and muddy surfaces.
The removable 48V 11.6AH Lithium-ion battery provides up to 40+ miles of range and can be fully charged in just 2-4 hours with the included 3A fast charger.
The Volcano's 500W rear hub motor provides effortless hill climbing and acceleration, allowing you to reach speeds of up to 20mph with ease.
The color TFT display informs you of essential ride information, including speed, distance, battery, and pedal assist level.
Experience a smooth ride on rough terrain with our suspension fork with MLO, or manual lock out, technology, providing improved traction control and shock absorption.
Keep your Volcano e-bike stable and secure with the strong and reliable aluminum kickstand.
Tackle any terrain with ease using the 3x7 Shimano gearing system. Easily switch between gears to optimize the balance between speed and effort.
Customize your ride with the Volcano's throttle and 5-level pedal assist. Choose between twist throttle mode, or select from one of the 5 power assist levels for a more personalized workout.
The puncture-resistant all-terrain tires provide exceptional durability and grip for a smooth and reliable ride on any adventure.
